title: Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship 2027: Win a $20,000 College Scholarship for Outstanding High School Seniors in the United States
summary: The Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship 2027 is now accepting applications from eligible high school seniors across the United States. Recognized as one of the country s most prestigious merit-based scholarship programs, the Coca-Cola Scholars Program rewards exceptional students who have demonstrated outstanding leadership, academic excellence, and a strong commitment to serving their schools and communities. Administered by the Coca-Cola Scholars Foundation , the program awards 150 scholarships worth $20,000 each every year to graduating high school seniors who have made meaningful contributions through leadership and community service. Since its establishment in 1986 , the Foundation has invested more than $90 million in scholarships and supported over 7,200 Coca-Cola Scholars , making it one of the nation s most respected scholarship initiatives. If you are a high-achieving student planning to pursue higher education in the United States, this scholarship presents an outstanding opportunity to receive financial support while joining a nationwide network of influential student leaders. About the Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship The Coca-Cola Scholars Program is an achievement-based scholarship , meaning recipients are selected based on their accomplishments rather than their financial need. Unlike many scholarship programs, applicants are evaluated on several qualities, including: Academic excellence Leadership potential Community service Positive impact on school and community Commitment to creating meaningful change The Foundation looks for students who have consistently demonstrated the ability to lead others, contribute to society, and excel academically throughout high school. Each year: 150 students are selected as Coca-Cola Scholars. Each recipient receives a $20,000 college scholarship . Scholars become part of an extensive alumni network of leaders making a difference across various professions and communities. Scholarship Value Successful applicants will receive: A $20,000 scholarship to support college education. Membership in the prestigious Coca-Cola Scholars alumni network. Leadership development opportunities. National recognition as a Coca-Cola Scholar. Opportunities to connect with fellow scholars and leaders from across the United States. Who Can Apply? To be eligible for the 2027 Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship, applicants must meet all of the following requirements: Educational Requirements Applicants must: Be currently enrolled as a high school or home-schooled student. Attend school in: One of the 50 U.S. states The District of Columbia Puerto Rico Or an eligible Department of Defense (DoD) school abroad. Graduate during the 2026–2027 academic school year . Plan to pursue a degree at an accredited U.S. post-secondary institution. Have a minimum cumulative GPA of 3.0 (B average) . Citizenship Requirements Applicants must be one of the following: U.S. Citizen U.S. National U.S. Permanent Resident Refugee Asylee Cuban-Haitian Entrant Humanitarian Parolee Applicants must meet these citizenship requirements at the time of application and no later than Wednesday, September 30, 2026 . A pending immigration application does not establish eligibility. Who Is Not Eligible? The following individuals are not eligible for the scholarship: International students (except students attending eligible Department of Defense schools abroad). Students attending American or expatriate schools outside the eligible geographic areas. High school graduates. Students who took a gap year or are non-traditional students. Temporary residents. Students graduating from: Guam U.S. Virgin Islands Northern Mariana Islands American Samoa American or expatriate schools abroad Children or grandchildren of current Coca-Cola employees, officers, owners, or certain retired employees receiving Coca-Cola retirement benefits. Is the Scholarship Based on Financial Need? No. The Coca-Cola Scholars Program is not a need-based or income-based scholarship . Instead, selection is based on: Leadership Academic achievement Service to school and community Financial need is not used as a selection criterion. Coca-Cola Scholars Selection Process The scholarship selection process consists of four competitive phases . Phase 1: Online Application The initial online application opens annually between August 3 and September 30 . During this stage: No essays are required. No transcript is required. No recommendation letters are required. Students simply complete the online application before the deadline. Phase 2: Semifinalists By the end of October: Applicants receive notification of their application status. Approximately 1% of applicants advance as Semifinalists. Semifinalists must submit: Essays Official transcript Recommendation letter Phase 3: Regional Finalists Around 250 Regional Finalists are selected from approximately 1,200 Semifinalists . These finalists participate in interviews conducted by Coca-Cola Scholar alumni and Foundation staff during late January or early February. Phase 4: Coca-Cola Scholars Following the interview process: 150 students are officially selected as Coca-Cola Scholars. Selected students attend the required Coke Scholars Weekend in Atlanta to confirm their selection. Application Period Applications for the 2027 Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship are open: Opening Date: Monday, August 3, 2026 Closing Date: Wednesday, September 30, 2026 Deadline Time: 5:00 PM Eastern Time Applicants are strongly encouraged to submit their applications well before the closing deadline to avoid technical issues or last-minute complications. APPLY NOW Why This Scholarship Stands Out The Coca-Cola Scholars Program has become one of America s most respected scholarship initiatives because it recognizes students who have already demonstrated exceptional leadership and service before entering college. Recipients not only receive substantial financial assistance but also gain access to a lifelong community of scholars, networking opportunities, leadership experiences, and national recognition. For ambitious high school seniors who aspire to create positive change in their communities, becoming a Coca-Cola Scholar represents both a significant honor and an investment in their future. Application Tips To improve your chances of success: Apply well before the September 30 deadline. Ensure your academic records reflect a minimum 3.0 GPA. Highlight meaningful leadership roles. Showcase community service activities with measurable impact. Prepare early in case you advance to the semifinalist stage, where essays, transcripts, and recommendation letters become required. Verify that you meet all citizenship and school eligibility requirements before applying. See FAQs here. Conclusion The 2027 Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship offers an exceptional opportunity for outstanding U.S. high school seniors to receive a $20,000 scholarship while joining one of the nation s most prestigious leadership communities. Rather than focusing on financial need, the Foundation seeks students who have demonstrated academic excellence, leadership, and a lasting commitment to serving others. Eligible students should take advantage of this opportunity by preparing their application early and ensuring they meet every eligibility requirement before the application deadline of 5:00 PM Eastern Time on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 . With only 150 scholarships awarded annually , the selection process is highly competitive, making early preparation and a strong application essential. title: Girls Who Invest Scholars Program 2027 Applications Open: Apply for Tuition-Free Investment Management Training and Career Development
summary: Applications are now open for the 2027 Girls Who Invest (GWI) Scholars Program , an exceptional tuition-free opportunity designed to equip undergraduate students with the technical knowledge, professional skills, and industry exposure needed to build successful careers in investment management and the broader financial services sector. The Girls Who Invest Scholars Program has become one of the leading career development initiatives dedicated to increasing diversity within the investment management industry. Through comprehensive education, career preparation, mentorship, and networking opportunities, the program empowers participants with the confidence, technical expertise, and leadership skills necessary to excel in one of the world s most competitive industries. Students interested in pursuing careers in finance, asset management, investment analysis, portfolio management, private equity, hedge funds, venture capital, and other investment-related fields are encouraged to submit their applications before the deadlines. About the Girls Who Invest Scholars Program The Girls Who Invest Scholars Program is a highly competitive educational and professional development initiative that provides participants with tuition-free learning experiences focused on investment management. The program combines technical financial education with career readiness training, allowing scholars to develop practical knowledge that employers in the investment industry highly value. Rather than focusing solely on classroom instruction, the program is designed to prepare students for long-term success by helping them build analytical, communication, leadership, and professional networking skills. Scholars gain access to educational resources that position them for careers not only in investment management but also across various sectors within finance and business. What the Program Offers Participants selected for the 2027 Scholars Program will benefit from numerous professional development opportunities, including: Tuition-free education and training Technical investment management instruction Career development workshops Professional skill-building sessions Exposure to investment industry practices Preparation for careers in finance and investment management Opportunities to strengthen leadership and communication skills Access to a professional network that supports long-term career growth The program aims to ensure that participants graduate with both technical competence and the professional confidence needed to thrive in highly competitive financial careers. Why You Should Apply The Girls Who Invest Scholars Program is more than a training initiative—it serves as a gateway into one of the world s fastest-growing and most influential industries. Benefits of participating include: Developing practical investment knowledge Strengthening financial analysis skills Enhancing professional communication abilities Building leadership capacity Expanding professional networks Improving career readiness Increasing competitiveness for internships and future employment opportunities Learning from professionals with industry expertise Students who aspire to become future leaders in investment management will find the program particularly valuable for developing both technical and interpersonal competencies. Application Requirements Applicants must carefully complete all sections of the online application. The application requires the following information and supporting documents: 1. Contact Information Applicants must provide accurate personal contact details. 2. Educational History Applicants must include information regarding their educational background and current enrollment status. 3. Written Responses Applicants are required to complete several written components, including: Mini reflections Short-answer questions A personal essay between 350 and 500 words These responses allow applicants to demonstrate their experiences, motivations, personal growth, and career aspirations. 4. Resume Each applicant must submit a resume that highlights: Work experience Leadership experience Extracurricular activities Volunteer work Campus involvement Relevant achievements 5. One-Minute Pre-Recorded Video Applicants are required to submit a one-minute recorded video according to the instructions provided within the application portal. This video serves as an opportunity for applicants to introduce themselves and showcase their communication skills, enthusiasm, and motivation for joining the program. 6. Academic Transcript Applicants must provide an academic transcript based on their educational status. Sophomore applicants must submit: Complete college transcript First-year applicants must submit: Complete high school transcript covering Grades 9–12 or equivalent coursework Unofficial transcripts are accepted. Applicants may submit transcripts after submitting their initial application if necessary. 7. Reference Feedback Forms Applicants applying for the Internship Track must submit: Two reference feedback forms Reference forms may also be submitted after the application has been submitted. Eligibility Confirmation During the application process, students will be asked to provide information regarding: Student type Undergraduate institution Expected graduation date Whether the institution is a two-year college This information helps determine eligibility and identifies the most appropriate application pathway. Application Process The Girls Who Invest application portal allows applicants to begin their applications and save their progress before submission. Applicants can return to edit and complete their applications multiple times before the final deadline. This flexible process enables students to gather supporting documents and carefully prepare thoughtful application responses without having to complete everything in a single session. APPLY NOW Important Deadlines Applicants should carefully note the following deadlines: Priority Application Deadline: September 15, 2026 Final Application Deadline: October 15, 2026 Applicants are encouraged to submit before the priority deadline whenever possible. Tips for a Strong Application To maximize your chances of selection, consider the following recommendations: Begin your application early. Prepare your essay well in advance. Update your resume to include your most recent experiences. Record a clear and professional one-minute video. Request transcripts early. If applying for the Internship Track, notify your references as soon as possible. Carefully proofread every section before submitting. Ensure all required documents are uploaded before the final deadline. The Girls Who Invest Scholars Program addresses this need by providing undergraduate students with access to high-quality education, career preparation, and industry-focused professional development at no tuition cost. Through this initiative, scholars develop the technical expertise and professional skills needed to pursue meaningful careers while contributing to a more inclusive and dynamic investment industry. Visit Apply and FAQ for more information. Conclusion The 2027 Girls Who Invest Scholars Program presents an outstanding opportunity for undergraduate students seeking to build successful careers in investment management and finance.
